t: You're looking at the Beaufort family tomb, in the churchyard gardens of St John at Hackney. Three members of the family are buried here. Sir Francis Beaufort was an Irish hydrographer and naval officer, and he created the Beaufort scale, which is still the name for the way wind strength is measured, along with the Beaufort cipher. Alongside him lie Honora Beaufort and Alicia Magdalena Beaufort. The records here say little more about those two, so the tomb is best known through Francis.
